empty.title: No places yet
empty.body: Fill in the Place field when you log a plate and your favourite eateries will show up here.
empty.bodyPlain: Fill in the Place field when you log a plate and your favourite eateries will show up here.

map.offline: The map needs internet. Try again later.

gesture.windows: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
gesture.mac: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the map
gesture.mobile: Use two fingers to move the map

empty.title: No saved locations yet
empty.body: Turn on “Save place location” below, then log a plate with a place name.

location.title: Saved location
location.body: Only about 100 m accurate, and only you can see it. Deleting it doesn't change your food log.

privacy.title: About location
privacy.note: Only you can see locations. They never show on your public profile or feed, and are deleted when you delete your data.

hint.off: Off by default. Only you can see it, and you can delete it any time.
hint.ready: Got your location. Saved at about 100 m accuracy, only you can see it.
hint.deniedWeb: Location permission was denied in the browser. Allow it in site settings first.
hint.deniedApp: Location permission was denied. Allow it in the app settings first.
hint.unavailable: Couldn't get your location. The plate is still saved without it.
